_comment: Kibana Alerting (Detection Engine) rule set for NemakiWare audit log. Import via Stack Management → Rules → Import. Pairs with filebeat-nemakiware.yml or vector-nemakiware.toml (Elasticsearch sink). Pre-deploy: replace every ${PLACEHOLDER}; verify rule appears in Rules tab; status 'Active' with last-run < interval is the success signal. The Watcher API equivalent of these rules is in the same shape — import with `POST _watcher/watch/<id>` after wrapping each rule body in the Watcher schema.
_index_mapping_hint: Before importing these rules, ensure your nemakiware-audit-* index has explicit keyword mappings for: userId, operation, repositoryId, result, details.principalId, details.removePrincipalIds, details.lostCount. The default dynamic mapping from Filebeat's ndjson parser will work but won't be aggregatable until you upgrade the mapping. Example PUT request in the README header of each rule.

rules.name: NemakiWare - governance simulate burst
rules._notification_action: Wire to ${NOTIFICATION_TARGET} via Kibana's Connectors. Not committed here (secrets).

rules.name: NemakiWare - asked-then-acted correlation
rules._comment: Native Kibana Alerting doesn't do cross-event correlation; this rule fires on the simulate side and the playbook step is manual lookup of follow-up acts via the linked Discover query. For automated correlation, use a Watcher with a chained input that joins on `userId.keyword` across the two queries.
rules._followup_discover_query: operation:(externalProfileUpdated OR externalProfileDeleted) AND userId:"<actor>" AND @timestamp >= "<sim_ts>" AND @timestamp <= "<sim_ts>+30m"

params.esQuery: { "query": { "bool": { "filter": [ { "term": { "operation.keyword": "externalGovernanceSimulate" } }, { "range": { "@timestamp": { "gte": "now-10m" } } }, { "script": { "script": { "source": "def h = doc['@timestamp'].value.withZoneSameInstant(ZoneId.of('${BUSINESS_HOURS_TZ:-UTC}')).getHour(); def dow = doc['@timestamp'].value.withZoneSameInstant(ZoneId.of('${BUSINESS_HOURS_TZ:-UTC}')).getDayOfWeek(); return (h < ${BUSINESS_HOURS_START_LOCAL:-6} || h >= ${BUSINESS_HOURS_END_LOCAL:-22} || dow == DayOfWeek.SATURDAY || dow == DayOfWeek.SUNDAY);", "lang": "painless" } } } ] } } }

rules.name: NemakiWare - new-actor first-time invoker
rules._comment: Detects an actor that emitted simulate now but not in the lookback window. Uses two aggregations chained via Watcher's `chain` input; the Kibana .es-query equivalent below is a single-window terms aggregation — the operator runs a separate Discover query to confirm the actor's history.
rules._followup_discover_query: operation:externalGovernanceSimulate AND userId:"<actor>" AND @timestamp < now-1h AND @timestamp > now-${NEW_ACTOR_LOOKBACK:-90d}
